messages.content: For the domain 'test4.org', how can I retrieve only the IDs and context attributes of community comments? Use the continuation cursor 'cur456' and my API key 'key123'.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑start guide you can copy/paste into your terminal (or adapt to whatever client you’re comfortable with).  
It shows **two** ways to pull *only* the `id` and `contextAttributes` fields for community comments while paging forward with the supplied cursor (`cur456`) and authenticating with your API key (`key123`).  

---

### 1️⃣ RESTful approach – simple JSON payload

```bash
curl -X POST \
     https://api.test4.org/v1/community-comments/query \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer key123" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     --data @-
```

Paste the following JSON body after the `--data @-` line:

```json
{
  "query": {
    "filter": {},
    "pagination": {
      "afterCursor": "cur456",
      "pageSize": 50          # adjust page size as desired
    },
    "selectFields": ["id","contextAttributes"]
  }
}
```

> **What happens:**  
> • The server returns up to 50 comment objects whose shape looks like:
>
> ```json
> [
>   {"id":"abc123","contextAttributes":{"foo":"bar"}},
>   ...
> ]
> ```
> • If more results remain, the response will contain `"nextCursor"`—use that value for subsequent requests.

---

### 2️⃣ GraphQL approach – concise field selection

If the service exposes a GraphQL endpoint at `/graphql`, run:

```bash
curl -X POST \
     https://api.test4.org/graphql \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer key123" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     --data '{"query":"query CommunityComments($cursor:String){communityComments(after:$cursor,pageSize:50){edges{node{id contextAttributes}}pageInfo{hasNextPage endCursor}}}","variables\":{\"cursor\":\"cur456\"}}"'
```

#### Expected result fragment

```json
{
  "data":{
    "communityComments":{
      "edges":[
        {"node":{"id":"xyz789","contextAttributes":{"topic":"sports"}}},
        …
      ],
      "pageInfo":{
        "hasNextPage":true,
        "endCursor":"cur457"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Use the returned `endCursor` when making the next call.

---

## Quick checklist

| Step | What to verify |
|------|----------------|
| ✅ URL | Make sure the base URL matches your environment (`https://api.test4.org/...`). |
| 🔑 Auth | Replace `Bearer key123` with your actual token/key. |
| 📄 Fields | Only `id` & `contextAttributes` appear in the select list / GraphQL projection. |
| ⏩ Cursor | Pass `cur456` as `afterCursor` (REST) or `$cursor` variable (GraphQL). |

Feel free to tweak `pageSize` or add additional filters once you’ve confirmed the basic flow works!
